001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.localization.text;
002
003import lombok.Data;
004import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
006
007import java.text.NumberFormat;
008import java.util.Locale;
009
010@Data
011public class ProxiedLocale {
012
013  private Locale locale;
014  @Nullable
015  private String origin;
016  private String relative;
017  private NumberFormat nf;
018
019  public ProxiedLocale(@Nullable final String origin, final String relative, @NotNull final NumberFormat nf, @NotNull final Locale locale) {
020
021    this.origin = origin;
022    this.relative = relative;
023    this.nf = nf;
024    this.locale = locale;
025  }
026
027  public String getLocale() {
028
029    return relative;
030  }
031
032  @NotNull
033  public NumberFormat getNumberFormat() {
034
035    return nf;
036  }
037
038  @NotNull
039  public Locale getJavaLocale() {
040
041    return locale;
042  }
043}
